# FIFA World Cup 2026 - AI Stadium Assistant
> Complete Autonomous AI-Powered Stadium Operations & Fan Experience Platform

## Project Overview
AI Stadium Assistant (Stadium-AI) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent operations platform built for the FIFA World Cup 2026. Powered by CrewAI, OpenRouter Multi-Model Routing, and Flask, it orchestrates 7 autonomous AI agents alongside real-time matchday telemetry, an interactive stadium zone radar, a digital match ticket wallet, in-seat concessions ordering, and speech AI in 10+ languages.

- **Author & Architect:** Alok Srivastava (https://github.com/alokinfo30)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/alokinfo30/Stadium-AI
- **License:** MIT License
- **Frameworks:** Python 3.11, CrewAI, Flask, OpenRouter, Pydantic, Web Speech API

## 7 Autonomous AI Agents
1. **Smart Wayfinder & Seat Navigator**: Turn-by-turn routing to seats, restrooms, elevators, and nearest concessions with walking time estimates.
2. **Dynamic Crowd Sentinel**: Real-time concourse crowd density analytics, bottleneck evasion, turnstile dissipation pacing, and emergency egress routing.
3. **Inclusive Accessibility Concierge**: 100% inclusive step-free access, Braille audio cues, sensory room bookings (Suite 104), and FM 94.2 MHz audio commentary.
4. **Multimodal Transit Dispatcher**: Live Metro Line 1 departures, park-and-ride shuttle status, rideshare pickup bays, and post-match highway clearance.
5. **Zero-Waste & Green Stadium Tracker**: Water refill station locator, stadium solar canopy telemetry (1.4 MW), compostable concession packaging, and fan eco-rewards.
6. **Real-Time Multilingual Translator**: 10+ languages with Web Speech voice input and text-to-speech audio synthesis.
7. **Command Operational Telemetry**: Gate throughput, turnstile wait dissipation, and automated medical/security marshal dispatch.

## Multi-Model Fallback Architecture
- **Primary Fast Model:** `openai/gpt-4o-mini`
- **Multilingual & Crowd Model:** `mistralai/mixtral-8x22b-instruct`
- **Accessibility & Operational Model:** `meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`
- **Transit Optimization Model:** `deepseek/deepseek-chat`
- **Fallback Rule:** Automated health checks ping active providers and seamlessly switch to secondary LLMs on network failure or rate limits.

## REST API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` -> Returns `{"status": "healthy", "service": "StadiumAI"}`
- `GET /api/models` -> Returns active and available LLM models
- `POST /api/service` -> Accepts `{ "service_type": str, "language": str, ...fields }` and routes to the dedicated CrewAI agent.
